{"consolidated_memory":"## NaN Feature in ml/features/encoder.py — Three Separate Incidents

**File:** ml/features/encoder.py (ml pipeline side)  
**Common Repro:** encode the batch holding the sparse column  
**Common Signal:** not-a-number value in one output column  
**Context:** All three fixes applied to the same corner of ml/features/encoder.py; context carried over between incidents  
**Test Coverage:** tests/ml/test_encoder.py

### Incident 1: Midnight Boundary Jobs [2026-04-22]

**Trigger:** Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary  
**Root Cause:** Two writes were never wrapped in a transaction  
**Fix:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction  
**PR/Branch:** PR #3499 on branch fix/nan-feature-1  
**Result:** Alert stayed quiet for 95 consecutive days

### Incident 2: Non-ASCII Names [2026-05-05]

**Trigger:** Records carrying non-ASCII names  
**Root Cause:** Unbounded retry loop with no backoff  
**Fix:** Capped the retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter  
**PR/Branch:** PR #7208 on branch fix/nan-feature-2  
**Result:** Throughput rose 14 percent to 102 requests per second  
**Stack:** Python

### Incident 3: Empty Input List [2026-08-27]

**Trigger:** Input list came in empty  
**Root Cause:** Connection pool exhaustion under burst load  
**Fix:** Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it  
**PR/Branch:** PR #7786 on branch fix/nan-feature-3  
**Result:** 98 duplicate rows a day stopped being written"}
